page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page, 269). Running head at top. Verse in the centre, with verse numbers in the left margin. Headings and a Greek-titled monostichon below. Continuous prose at the foot, with a large initial. The left edge of the scan shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p:
Iustitiam humanam summi rex spernit Olympi,
Sed spem coelestem nos decet usque sequi.

4 Pergite constantes, concordi pergite sensu,
Et vos commendet vita modesta simul.

Gratia sit, fratres, largo pro munere vobis.
Dicatur sanctis fratribus alma salus.
main_text.head: ALITER.
CAP. I
main_text.p:
Acito pro vobis grates, mea vincula crescant,
Gaudent, mors lucrum est, vos quoq; damna iuvent.

1 Bis ter magnus honor Christum decet ista ferentem,
Discipulos laudas optime Paule, tuos.

3 Cæsa lucra cum sperno, quo lucrer Iesum.
Quæ sunt a tergo mitto, cauete malos.

4 Dilecti, state. & gaudete, & honesta patrate.
Sperno quidem esuriem, sed tamen ista placent.
main_text.head: MONOSTICHON συμβολικόν.
Declaratio.
main_text.p: Dissolui cupio & esse cum Christo: v. 23 Flectatur omne genu ad mentionem Iesu: v. 10. ad anteriora contendo, scopum versus, ad palmam supernæ vocationis, v. 14. Corona mea vos estis: v. 1.
main_text.head: ANALYSIS EPISTO-LAE AD COLOSSEN-SES.
main_text.p: COLOSSÆ fuit civitas in minori Asia ad confluentem Lyci & Meandri sita, vicina

page.notes: Verse numbers 1, 3 and 4 in the left margin are transcribed as notes. Initial "A" of "Acito" is a large drop letter; reading of "Acito" is doubtful [?] and is not marked in the text. Line "Dilecti... patrate" and "Dilecti" spelling as read. Faint show-through of the reverse page is ignored. Left strip (neighbouring page) is not transcribed. The top-right mark at the running head is a printer's or scan artefact, not text.
